rows.label: Elon Musk
rows.hook: runs an electric-car maker and dreams of putting people on Mars

rows.label: Steve Jobs
rows.description: American entrepreneur; co-founder of Apple Inc. (1955–2011)
rows.hook: unveiled the iPhone after being ousted from and then rehired by the company he co-founded

rows.label: Jensen Huang
rows.description: American entrepreneur and businessman; co-founder and CEO of Nvidia
rows.hook: leads the leather-jacketed chipmaker whose graphics processors power the AI boom

rows.label: Steve Wozniak
rows.description: American computer pioneer, inventor, computer engineer and programmer; co-founder of Apple Inc.
rows.hook: hand-built the circuit boards of the first personal computers sold by his friend's startup

rows.label: Larry Page
rows.description: American computer scientist and Internet entrepreneur (born 1973)
rows.hook: co-created the ranking algorithm behind the world's biggest search engine

rows.label: Sergey Brin
rows.hook: co-founded an online search giant alongside a fellow Stanford PhD student

rows.label: Demis Hassabis
rows.hook: leads an AI lab whose program beat the world champion at Go and won a Nobel Prize in Chemistry

rows.label: Alexander Graham Bell
rows.hook: won the first patent for a practical telephone

rows.label: Tim Berners-Lee
rows.hook: invented the system of linked pages and browsers we all use to surf online

rows.label: Paul Allen
rows.description: American businessman and philanthropist, co-founder of Microsoft (1953–2018)
rows.hook: co-founded a famous software company with a school friend and owned Seattle's NFL team

rows.label: Sid Meier
rows.hook: designed the long-running strategy game series about building a civilization from the ground up

rows.label: Isambard Kingdom Brunel
rows.hook: designed record-setting iron steamships and a famed tunnel beneath the Thames

rows.label: Vint Cerf
rows.hook: co-designed the TCP/IP protocols that let networks talk to each other

rows.label: Masayoshi Son
rows.hook: made an early investment in the Chinese e-commerce giant Alibaba that grew into billions

rows.label: Richard Stallman
rows.description: American software freedom activist, short story writer and computer programmer, founder of the GNU project
rows.hook: launched a movement for users' freedom to copy and change code and wrote the GPL licence

rows.label: Steve Chen
rows.hook: co-founded a video-sharing site whose first clip showed a visit to the zoo

rows.label: John Carmack
rows.description: American computer programmer and video game developer (born 1970)
rows.hook: programmed the groundbreaking first-person shooters Doom and Quake

rows.label: Vannevar Bush
rows.description: American electrical engineer and science administrator (1890–1974)
rows.hook: led America's wartime science effort and imagined a desk-sized memory machine called the Memex

rows.label: John Pemberton
rows.hook: invented a fizzy soft drink that began as a medicinal syrup in an Atlanta pharmacy
